resources.string: Shows this device\'s notifications on your Windows PC. Set it up from the Tandem app on the PC.

Turns Wireless debugging back on after a restart or when Wi-Fi drops, on Wi-Fi where your PC has connected (%1$d remembered). If you switch it off yourself, it stays off until you switch it on again.
